verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a cloud file-storage product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant or Copilot inside OneDrive, or any way to delegate tasks to one. The pack covers only Graph file APIs, sharing, sync, versioning and developer sandboxes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
